answer: Work credits are nectar: they evaporate unless an identity submits a crystal receipt each cycle, and that receipt must come from the exact state it earned, since a replay check reruns it and rejects forged or copied state. Each cycle a ripple sample of identities is drawn from a recorded seed, so an operator needs every head independently replayable at once rather than one machine serving them serially. The k-th replay seat one operator keeps costs k squared, so n heads sustain n squared rent per cycle, and sharing one replay engine collapses them into one identity.
